_about: Shared, public settings of the hermetic layer. Read by the stack launcher (plain Node) and by the tests (through e2e/env/hermetic.ts). Nothing here is a secret.

fork._about: Anvil forks Sepolia at this pinned block. The default RPC is a public, keyless archive endpoint; override it with E2E_FORK_RPC_URL (never commit a URL that contains a key). When the block changes, regenerate the subgraph baseline: yarn test:e2e:baseline.

ports._about: Fixed local ports, all bound on 127.0.0.1 except alto, which has no host flag and binds 0.0.0.0. appVariant is a second app server that a test starts for itself, with server settings of its own (e2e/support/app-variant.ts); it is not part of the running stack.

stacks._about: A run with several workers (E2E_WORKERS) starts one whole stack per worker. Stack i listens on every port above plus i * portStep. max is the highest number of stacks; with these values no two ports of any two stacks collide.

TEST_ONLY_MNEMONIC._about: TEST-ONLY. Public on purpose. Used only on the local Anvil fork. Never fund these addresses on a real network and never reuse this phrase anywhere.
TEST_ONLY_MNEMONIC.phrase: moon start hair oval upset then tip off wool castle verb bacon

indexes._about: Derivation path m/44'/60'/0'/0/i. Anvil funds 0..3 with 10,000 ETH each. The `legacy` persona uses the wallets from legacyStart on (see legacyAccounts). Test personas use indexes from personaStart upwards.

contracts._about: Sepolia deployments the fakes need to know. e2e/env/hermetic.ts checks them against src/consts/contracts.ts.

legacyAccounts._about: Old wallet => Society address (its Light Account v2, salt 0) of the test keys at indexes legacyStart, legacyStart + 1, ... in this order. The launcher compiles them into the tested build as NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_LEGACY_ACCOUNTS (src/lib/e2e-legacy-accounts.ts), which adds them to the app's legacy account map: that map is fixed at build time, so these wallets are fixed too. Only for the local fork; never add them to src/consts/legacy-account-map.json. The `legacy` persona checks each pair against the key it derives.

auction._about: The auction id compiled into the tested build (NEXT_PUBLIC_AUCTION_ID). null: the build has none, /auction says 'Coming soon', and the auction specs that need one (M2 to M10) skip themselves. To run them, set it to auctionCounter() + 1 of the EasyAuction contract at the fork block; e2e/support/builders/auction.ts then creates that auction on the fork. One build shows either state, never both.
